Date 22/4/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

31st April 1916

Sir,
An alleged rebel named Zung Tsoong Hsien 陳忠憲
was arrested in Chapei on 20th inst, and is at present
detained in the Chapei Central Police Station.
It is reported that on 19th inst, detectives from
the Arsenal in conjunction with the French Police
searched Nos. 25 and 26 Pao Kong Li, Avenue Joffre,
alleged residences of rebels, but found nothing. It is
said that at the time this search was being made that
a rebel leader named Woo An 吳浩 was dividing some
money amongst his followers in Nos. 21 and 22 of the
same alleyway.
It is reported that the rebels have now little hope
of starting a rising here. Many of them have left for
Wusih and Soochow within the past few days.
It is reported that irreconcilable differences exist
between the rebel leaders Chen Chi Mei and Nyeu Tih
Sung.
It is reported that a high official named Woo Ching
Sing has arrived here from Peking with presents for
the military officers at Woosung and the Arsenal.
It is reported that thirty men were shot at
Woosung the day before yesterday for attempting to
desert.

Your obedient servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Entered on m.s. Apl. 21.

刑事侦缉处 (C. I. D.)
情报官登记册 (I. O. REG)
编号 221
日期 1916年4月22日

上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探分部。）

1916年4月31日

先生：

一名涉嫌叛乱分子陈忠宪 (Zung Tsoong Hsien) 于本月20日在闸北被捕，目前羁押于闸北中央巡捕房。

据报，本月19日，兵工厂的侦探与法国警察联合搜查了霞飞路宝康里25号和26号，该处据称为叛乱分子的住所，但未发现任何物品。据悉，在进行此次搜查时，一名名为吴浩 (Woo An) 的叛乱头目正在同一条弄堂的21号和22号向其追随者分发钱财。

据报，叛乱分子目前对在此地发动起义已不抱太大希望。过去几天内，他们中的许多人已前往无锡和苏州。

据报，叛乱头目陈其美与钮永建 (Nyeu Tih Sung) 之间存在不可调和的分歧。

据报，一位名为吴景星 (Woo Ching Sing) 的高级官员已从北京抵达此地，并携带礼物送给吴淞和兵工厂的军官们。

据报，前天在吴淞有三十人因企图开小差而被枪决。

您顺从的仆人，

总探长。

警务处总监。

录入于手稿，4月21日。
